check.definitions: Hit: forecast and hindsight are both haze days (district daily mean PM10 at or above threshold_pm10_ugm3). Miss: haze in hindsight, not in the forecast. False alarm: haze in the forecast, not in hindsight. POD (probability of detection) = hits / (hits + misses). FAR (false alarm ratio) = false alarms / (hits + false alarms). Hindsight is archived model data, not station measurements, so this measures how well the morning forecast matched the model's later estimate, not accuracy against measured air quality.

source: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (2021): CAMS global atmospheric composition forecasts.
